items.question: What are the check-in and check-out times?
items.answer: Check-in time is 2:00 PM and check-out time is 12:00 PM. Early check-in and late check-out can be arranged based on availability.

items.question: Do you offer airport transfers?
items.answer: Yes, we provide airport transfer services for our guests. Please contact our reservations team to arrange this service prior to your arrival.

items.question: Is there a restaurant in the hotel?
items.answer: Yes, we have multiple dining options including a main restaurant serving international cuisine, a specialty restaurant, and 24-hour room service.

items.question: Do you have parking facilities?
items.answer: Yes, we offer complimentary parking for all our guests. Valet parking service is also available.

items.question: Is Wi-Fi available throughout the hotel?
items.answer: Yes, high-speed Wi-Fi is available free of charge throughout the entire hotel, including all guest rooms and public areas.
